welcome.point-classes-body: GrapeStrap edits Bootstrap classes, not inline styles. Reach for spacing/text/background panels instead of custom CSS for most things.
welcome.point-sync-body: Edits in Design view flow to Code view continuously. Edits in Code view rebuild the canvas only when you switch back to Design — and selection resets. This is intentional.

sm.nav.no-navbar: Select a navbar to edit its behavior.

sm.anim.hover-hint: Hover effects are pure CSS — hover the element on the canvas to see it.
sm.anim.marquee-hint: Marquee copies this element's contents once when the page loads so the strip can loop without a gap — the copies are made by the runtime and are never saved into your page.
